activities.title: Listen. Mateo shows his room. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Mateo (tour de su cuarto) y Valentina (riéndose).
data.script: Mateo: Welcome to my room! There is a bed, a desk and a big wardrobe. … Mateo: On the wall there are three posters of planets. … Valentina: What's under the bed, Mateo? … Mateo: Emm… my sock museum. Fifteen socks, all without their partner. … Valentina: Fifteen! And what's on the desk? … Mateo: My homework, my robot and a cup with seven pencils. … Valentina: And that noise in the wardrobe? … Mateo: Luna! She sleeps there when it rains. It's her cave!
